priorities.topic: Real-time rail network visualization: GB and France live maps go viral on Hacker News
priorities.angle: Two interactive real-time rail maps (Great Britain and France) both hit HN top stories simultaneously with 249+ and 100+ points. Why does this captivate the internet? Deep dive into open transit data standards (GTFS-RT, Network Rail feeds, SNCF open data), why US transit still can't match this at scale, and what LA Metro and other US agencies would need to get there.
priorities.rationale: Highest HN signal of the week directly in our niche. Two simultaneous viral rail-map stories is a once-a-season opportunity to ride organic interest in live transit data. Not yet covered. Time-sensitive — HN cycle is 24-48h.

priorities.topic: How real-time transit data flows: from GPS transponder to rider's phone map
priorities.angle: Visual explainer of the GTFS-Realtime pipeline — vehicle location beacon → agency feed server → GTFS-RT protobuf → aggregator/broker → consumer app → map tile. Show why GB works (Network Rail mandatory feeds) vs why US is fragmented (no federal mandate, 700+ agencies, 14 different AVL systems).
priorities.rationale: Companion piece to Rank 1 article that stands alone as a shareable visual. Fresh topic — brt-vs-light-rail retries are suspended. First new infographic topic since 07-02.
